description: The second sister proclaims the end of the world. "I think this world full of fakes should just be destroyed, onii-chan." What kind of burning justice will Araragi Koyomi's sister, Tsukihi, carry out!? Nisemonogatari concludes in grand style!

This is the story of a... human who plays a forbidden game towards becoming a monster. Those "nightmarish nine days", once sealed off and hidden, is now finally revealed!

arcs: Episode Snug: Tsubasa Tiger

description: "I don't know everything, but I know a lot about you, Araragi-kun."
The flawless class president Hanekawa Tsubasa's first day of the second semester is closely watched by a monstrous tiger. Amidst the lifeless monologue is an unreachable confession...

arcs: Episode Idle: Mayoi Jiangshi
第閑話 まよいキョンシー
description: Araragi Koyomi and Oshino Shinobu decided to time travel back into 11 years ago using up the remaining spirit particles at the shrine from Nadeko Snake. In their adventure, Koyomi saved Hachikuji Mayoi from the car accident that killed her. When they returned to the present, they discover the world has changed drastically as a consequence of what Koyomi has done. Now they have to find an alternate way to get back to their original world.

arcs: Episode Change: Suruga Devil
第変話 するがデビル
description: "If you can't be the medicine, be poison. Otherwise Otherwise you're nothing but water."
After Araragi Koyomi has graduated, Kanbaru Suruga goes towards her third year in high school. Alone in Naoetsu High School, she hears the rumors of " a demon that grants any wish"...
The story slowly sinks into the depths ー
A story to meet and unveil the mystery.

arcs: Episode Chaos: Nadeko Medusa
第乱話 なでこメドゥーサ
description: "—You're a liar, even though you're already a god".
The girl who was once possessed by a winding serpent, Sengoku Nadeko.
The girl who has been in love with Araragi Koyomi for so long now appears as an "angel" in pure white. But her true colors are...?
As the "story" approaches its final chapter, it twists around, entangling, evolving—.

arcs: Episode Endure: Shinobu Time
第忍話 しのぶタイム
description: Immediately following the events of Kabukimonogatari, Araragi and Hachikuji begin having run-ins with a near-indescribable void, which seems to be pursuing them for reasons they cannot determine. The answer to the question, and the solution to their predicament, lies in the memories of Shinobu and the insight of literal know-it-all Gaen Izuko.

arcs: Episode Love: Hitagi End
第恋話 ひたぎエンド
description: "Don't you think unrequited love that lasts forever is happier than mutual love?"
Senjougahara Hitagi made a deal with the gods with her life in order to protect Araragi Koyomi.
As winter holidays approach with the promised "destined day", she chose the darkest and the worst option...

arcs: Episode Body: Yotsugi Doll
第体話 よつぎドール
description: "Please!—Do it, and get it over with." Slowly but surely, Araragi Koyomi, who "has been averting his eyes from reality", has no choice but to face it. February comes, and the college entrance exam is approaching. What is this "change" that is happening to his body that cannot be overlooked? The "story" begins to sprint towards its conclusion. This is Oddity taking place in the modern world! In a story of youth, a word of farewell is inevitable.

Koyomi has a plan related to Hitagi and Shinobu? These are the modern-day Oddities! Oddities! Oddities!

Oshino Meme and Kaiki Deishuu, members of the Sakaimiyako University Occult Research Club, are invited by their senior and leader, Gaen Izuko, to take part in a forbidden ritual. Together with the high school girl Kagenui Yozuru, they scramble to make preparations, but the project takes an unexpected turn-! It's a modern-day Oddity! Oddity! Oddity!
A doll stitched together out of youth itself.
"I think a world so full of fakes like this might as well just be destroyed, onii-chan."
Araragi Tsukihi has vanished.
She completely outwitted the surveillance of none other than Gaen Izuko.
The order to assassinate the phoenix is reignited!
Running around in search of the bird, Ononoki Yotsugi's partner is... the popular manga artist, Sengoku Nadeko—!?
These are the modern-day Oddities! Oddities! Oddities!
Rising again from the ashes of youth.
